text: The secret of the colour of the wind The money box was mine, I couldn't find it anyway Quietly I strolled about the technical field Till I met a man who smoked a pipe and said I must be killed But sir, you have a wooden leg like mine Sorry to have troubled you, call me anytime I found a station, the shapes are straight A fat policeman asked me my name My soul was broken
